# ILikeFish.Space

> ILikeFish.Space is a free, account-free browser game arcade. It hosts small HTML5 games that can be played instantly, many of which work offline after the site is loaded. The site is operated by fishesarethings and is released under the Unlicense unless a game says otherwise.

Canonical site: https://ilikefish.space/
Contact: https://ilikefish.space/contact.html · https://github.com/fishesarethings/Ilikefish.space/issues
Last updated: 2026-10-25

## What the site offers

- 18 small browser games across arcade, puzzle, idle/tycoon, strategy, educational and casual categories.
- No account, download or purchase is required to play.
- The site is a progressive web app with offline support for cached pages.
- Game progress and preferences are stored locally in the browser.
- A local-only recommendation system ranks games from the visitor’s play history; no play history is sent to a server.
- Advertising is provided by Google AdSense. Ads are labelled and kept outside the game area.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://ilikefish.space/): featured and recommended games, all games, game-maker link.
- [All games](https://ilikefish.space/games/): the complete playable catalogue.
- [Game player](https://ilikefish.space/games/game_player.html): the shared player wrapper; use ?folder=<folder> to open a game.
- [Game Maker](https://ilikefish.space/gamepack/): build and export a small game package.
- [About](https://ilikefish.space/about.html): who runs the site and how it works.
- [Contact](https://ilikefish.space/contact.html): questions, bugs, submissions and removal requests.
- [Privacy](https://ilikefish.space/privacy.html) and [Terms](https://ilikefish.space/terms.html).

Supports keyboard (WASD + Arrow keys), gamepad, and touch controls (on-screen buttons). Tags: arcade, snake, grid, 2-player, local-multiplayer, fast, challenge, skill, keyboard, gamepad, touch, boost.

## Technical notes

- Pages are static HTML/CSS/JavaScript hosted on GitHub Pages and delivered through Cloudflare.
- The player wraps each game in an iframe; games are plain HTML5/JS and do not require a plugin.
- `/llms-full.txt` contains a longer machine-readable catalogue with controls and feature notes.
- The site does not require login and does not expose private user data.
